depth_targets.title: DynamoDB stream details
depth_targets.current_reason: DynamoDB Streams is a separate change-data-capture API (shard iterators, GetRecords, trim-horizon, Lambda event-source mapping) that Vyomi's single-process store does not model.

depth_targets.title: Imports from S3
depth_targets.current_reason: ImportTable requires parsing multiple external file formats (CSV, DynamoDB JSON, Amazon Ion; optionally GZIP/ZSTD-compressed) from arbitrary S3 content, which Vyomi does not implement; only the export direction (ExportTableToPointInTime) is built.

depth_targets.title: Amazon Kinesis data stream details
depth_targets.current_reason: Kinesis Data Streams for DynamoDB (change-data-capture into a Kinesis stream) is a separate streaming product Vyomi does not run.

depth_targets.title: Resource-based policy
depth_targets.current_reason: Resource-based policies need the full cross-account IAM policy-evaluation engine (condition keys, principal matching) that Vyomi's single-tenant simulator does not implement.

depth_targets.title: CloudWatch metrics and alarms
depth_targets.current_reason: CloudWatch is a separate monitoring product (its own metric pipeline and alarm-evaluation engine) that Vyomi does not run for any service.
depth_targets.hint: telemetry: emit real metrics/logs from the simulated engine (wave-6 Prometheus/OTel are the offline sinks once landed; until then derive real series from actual API activity in the core) — never synthetic random data
